Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Added a panel to a Grafana dashboard
- Selected the built-in Grafana data source
- Wrote a Random Walk query and viewed the results
- Saved your panel to the dashboard
